## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric *yoga* practice manual by **Vajrabodhi** ([金剛智](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%87%91%E5%89%9B%E6%99%BA)) for the **Avalokiteśvara-King** (Vajradhātu Lotus-family principal) practice. Companion to [KR6j0103](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0103) (Amoghavajra's later version of the same practice), this Vajrabodhi text is the **earlier Táng** rendering of the practice.

**Abstract**

The text establishes Vajrabodhi's earlier Táng version of the Vajradhātu Avalokiteśvara-King practice. The two recensions (Vajrabodhi's [KR6j0104](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0104) and Amoghavajra's [KR6j0103](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0103)) document the development of the Táng Esoteric Avalokiteśvara practice tradition through two generations of master-translators.

The translation dates from Vajrabodhi's Cháng'ān period (720–741).
